title: FATHER GOD, LET OPPORTUNITITES LOCATE ME TODAY
text: Lift your hands wherever you are and let's just worship him for a moment. Just worship him. Bless the name of the Lord. Father, we thank you. We honor you. You are the God of all flesh and there is nothing too hard for you. We bless your name this morning. We worship you ancient of days. We magnify your name Lord God Almighty. Thank you for the gift of life. Thank you for breath. Thank you that we are live to see this day. Not everyone who slept last night woke up [music] this morning, but you in your mercy preserved us. You kept us and we are here. So Father, receive our praise. Receive our worship. Receive our adoration. You alone are worthy. You alone are holy. You alone are God. Now let's go into this morning's place of prayer. I want you to be sensitive in your spirit because what we are about to do is not a religious exercise. This is a divine transaction. There are forces of limitation, forces of obscurity, forces that keep men hidden, forces that prevent destiny from flourishing and we are going to deal with every one of them this morning in the name of Jesus. So stay with me. Don't let your mind wander. This is your moment. This is your morning. Heaven is open and God is ready to move on your behalf. The title of what God has laid in my heart this morning is this. Father, let opportunities locate [music] me today. I want you to say that. Say it like you mean it. Father, let opportunities locate me today. Say it again. Father, let opportunities locate me today. Now hold that in your spirit because we are going to unpack it. We are going to pray it. We are going to declare it and by the time we are done this morning something will have shifted in your life. Now listen to me. One of the most profound spiritual realities that many believers have not grasped is that opportunity is not accidental. Opportunity is not random. Opportunity is not just coincidence dressed up in nice clothing. Opportunity is a divine instrument in the hands of God that he uses to connect a man to his season. Let me say that again. Opportunity is a divine instrument. God uses opportunity as a vehicle to move you from where you are to where he has ordained you to be. This is why the enemy fights opportunity. This is why the enemy builds walls around men. This is why delay and obscurity and hiddenness are tools of the adversary because if he can keep you from the right opportunity at the right time, he can frustrate an entire destiny. But I want you to know something this morning. Psalm 75:6 and 7 says, "For promotion cometh neither from the east, nor from the west, nor from the south. But God is the judge. He putted down one and set it up another." This means your next level is not in the hands of a man. Your next level is not dependent on who likes you, who knows you, or who is impressed by you. Your next level is held in the hands of Jehovah and when he decides to promote you, there is no embargo, there is no roadblock, there is no conspiracy, there is nothing the enemy can do to stop it. So what we are doing this morning is positioning ourselves in prayer before the God who holds our seasons, the God who controls our opportunities and we are asking him to activate what belongs to us. I want to draw your attention to the life of Ruth. The book of Ruth is one of the most beautiful portraits of divine opportunity I have ever encountered in scripture. Here is a woman, a widow, a foreigner, someone with no connection, no status, no network, no reference point in [music] Israel. By every human calculation Ruth had nothing going for her. She was not connected. She was not known. She did not have a CV that would open doors. She was a Moabite woman in a Jewish land, but watch what happened. Ruth chapter 2:3. And she went and came and gleaned in the field after the reapers. And her hap was to light on a part of the field belonging unto Boaz. Her hap was to light The word hap there in Hebrew speaks of something that appears coincidental, but is orchestrated by divine providence. God set it up. Ruth did not know Boaz's field from anyone else's field. She just went out to glean. She was faithful in the little. She was diligent in the moment and God directed her steps to the exact field where her redemption was waiting. Boaz was not just any man. He was a [music] kinsman redeemer. He was wealthy. He was honorable. He was in position to completely transform [music] Ruth's situation. And God took this widow with no connections, no status, no platform and walked her right into the most strategic relationship of her entire life. This is what I am praying for you this morning. I am praying that just like Ruth, you will stumble into greatness. I am praying that you will walk into rooms that are connected to your destiny. I am praying that the very next field you enter will have a Boaz waiting for you. That the very next conversation you have will be the conversation that changes everything. That the very next door you knock on will swing open. Why? Because God has already gone ahead of you and prepared the way. Now let me tell you something about opportunity that will bless you deeply. Opportunity has two sides to it. There is the side of grace and there is the side of readiness. On one side God is the one who opens doors. On the other side you must be ready to walk through them. Ecclesiastes 9:11 says, "I returned and saw under the sun that the race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong, neither yet bread to the wise, nor yet riches to men of understanding, nor yet favor to men of skill, but time and chance happeneth [music] to them all." Time and chance. Every man will encounter moments of opportunity. The question is whether you are ready when the moment comes. Because an opportunity that meets an unprepared man is just a moment passing by, but an opportunity that meets a prepared man becomes a turning point. This is why I always tell people preparation is a form of prayer. When you are sharpening your skills, when you are studying, when you are developing your gift, when you are cultivating your character, you are not just working, you are praying in another form. You are saying to God, "I believe that the opportunity is coming and I'm getting ready for it." And God [music] honors that kind of faith. So this morning as we pray for opportunities to locate us, we must also be committed to be men and women who are ready. Ready in character, ready in knowledge, ready in spirit, ready in capacity. But beyond readiness, I want to talk to you about the spiritual dimension of opportunity because there are satanic forces whose assignment is specifically to block opportunities. Let me show you something. In Daniel chapter 10, the prophet Daniel prayed for 21 [music] days. For three full weeks he fasted and prayed. And the angel came to him and said, "From the first day that thou didst set thine heart to understand and to [music] chasten thyself before thy God, thy words were heard and I am come for thy words." But then the angel said something remarkable. He said, "The prince of the kingdom of Persia withstood me 1 and 20 days." There was a demonic principality, a spiritual force of darkness that was assigned to resist the answer, to delay the breakthrough, to hold back the provision. And if you understand this, you will understand why some people are brilliant but never seem to get their break. You will understand why some people are qualified but never seem to get the opportunity. There is a spiritual warfare dimension to opportunity. This is why you cannot afford to be prayerless. This is why your morning prayer is not optional. This is why we must engage in spiritual [music] warfare because the principalities and powers of darkness are not impressed by your talent. They are not moved by your qualification, but they are terrified of a praying man. They are terrified of a praying woman. They cannot stand before the authority of the name of Jesus backed by genuine faith. [music] And so this morning, we are going to deal with every prince of Persia that has been blocking your opportunities. We are going to command every hold up, every delay, every satanic embargo on your destiny [music] to be broken in the name of Jesus. Think about Joseph. Now Joseph is one of my favorite portraits of divine opportunity management. Here is a young man whose brothers threw him in a pit, sold him to Ishmaelite traders. He ends up as a slave in Egypt. He gets falsely accused by Potiphar's wife. He ends up in prison. And every time you look at Joseph's story, the next chapter seems darker than the previous one. But watch something. In Genesis 41, Pharaoh has a dream. And none of his wise men can interpret it. And the butler suddenly remembers a young Hebrew man in prison who interpreted his dream correctly. And Pharaoh sends for Joseph. And Joseph is brought out of prison. And within one conversation, one divine appointment, one moment of opportunity, Joseph goes from prisoner to prime minister. From the dungeon to the palace. From obscurity to the second most powerful position in the known world. In one day, one encounter, one opportunity. I want to announce to somebody this morning [music] that God is preparing a Joseph moment for you. One meeting is all it takes. One phone call is all it takes. One introduction is all it takes. One dream interpreted, one problem solved, one moment of showing up ready and your entire story changes. But notice, Joseph was ready. He was not bitter. He was not broken. He had maintained his relationship with God in the pit, [music] in the slave house, in the prison, everywhere Joseph went, the Lord was with him. And because the Lord was with him, he could not stay down. The Bible says the Lord was with Joseph and showed him mercy and gave him favor in the sight of the keeper of the prison. Favor is supernatural. Favor is when God makes people treat you better than your circumstances warrant. Favor is when the enemy has built a case against you, but God overrides the verdict. This is what I'm praying for you this morning. That the favor of God will precede you. That everywhere you go, before you even arrive, God will have been there ahead of you preparing the hearts of men, turning the atmosphere, creating divine appointments, setting up encounters that look coincidental, but are actually engineered from the throne of grace. Now, let us talk about this phrase, let opportunities locate me. It is interesting because we're not saying let me locate opportunities. We're saying let opportunities locate me. This is a prophetic posture. This is a faith declaration that says, I believe God is the author of my opportunities. I believe he can cause the right things to find me. I believe he can make the right people seek me out. I believe he can cause favor to come looking for me, rather than me chasing it down. There is a difference between a man who is chasing opportunities and a man who has been so positioned by God that opportunities are chasing him. I want you to get into that second category. Proverbs 18:16 says, a man's gift maketh room for him and bringeth him before great men. Your gift, when developed and consecrated to God, will open doors for you that no amount of networking, no amount of manipulation, no amount of human strategy can open. When God is behind a gift, it attracts opportunity. It creates room. It brings a man before great men. Not great men in the sense of celebrity, but great men in the sense of those who are positioned to help you fulfill your destiny. Ruth's gift of loyalty brought her before Boaz. Joseph's gift of dream interpretation brought him before Pharaoh. David's gift of music brought him before King Saul. Every man's door is his gift. And this morning I'm praying that whatever God has placed in you will be so activated, so sharpened, so anointed that it will begin to create rooms that you cannot create for yourself. Now, I want to talk to you about faith and the role it plays in attracting opportunity. Hebrews 11:1 says, now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen. Faith is substance. It is not wishful thinking. It is not positive confession without content. Faith is actual spiritual substance that when it is active in the life of a believer, it begins to attract the things that are in the realm of the spirit into the realm of the natural. When you believe God for opportunities, your faith becomes like a magnet. It begins to draw towards you the things that God has already prepared for you in the heavenly places. Ephesians 2:10 says, for we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus onto good works, which God had before ordained that we should walk in them. These works were before ordained. These opportunities were not improvised by God this morning. Before you were born, before you took your first breath, God had already ordained the works that you would walk in. He had already prepared the paths that your feet would tread. He had already set up the appointments, the encounters, the open doors. The question is not whether the opportunities exist. The question is whether you are walking in the place of alignment, the place of obedience, the place of prayer and preparation that allows you to encounter what God has already prepared. And this is why I love this kind of morning prayer, because when we pray, we are not informing God of something he does not know. We are aligning ourselves with something he has already prepared. We are saying, God, I believe you have things prepared for me. I believe you have doors that are already open. I believe you have people already positioned in my path. And I'm agreeing with your plan this morning. I am saying yes to what you have already said yes to. This is the power of prayer. Not changing God's mind, but aligning our will with his. Not informing heaven, but enforcing on earth what heaven has already decreed. Let me talk to you now about timing, because one of the most dangerous prayers a man can pray is to receive an opportunity in the wrong season. Some people receive their blessing before they are ready for it, and the blessing becomes a curse. A promotion to a position you are not ready for will expose you, rather than elevate you. A relationship that comes before you have dealt with your character issues will magnify your flaws, rather than compliment your strengths. This is why we must not just pray for opportunities. We must [music] pray for the wisdom to know when to move, the grace to be patient in the season of preparation, and the discernment to recognize the moment when it arrives. Ecclesiastes 3:1 says, to everything there is a season and a time to every purpose under the heaven. There is a time for everything. And when the time comes, nothing can stop it. But when the time has not yet come, no [clears throat] amount of pushing and striving and forcing will bring it prematurely without consequence. So, even as we pray this morning, we pray with wisdom. We pray, Father, let the right opportunities come in the right season. Let me be ready when they come. Let me have the wisdom to recognize them when they arrive. Let me have the courage to take hold of them when they show up, because some people recognize their opportunity, but are too afraid to step into it. Fear of failure, fear of what people will say, fear of the unknown, and they let the moment pass, and then they spend years wondering what might have been. I am praying for you this morning that God will give you the courage that is commensurate with the opportunity. That when your moment comes, you will be bold enough, you will be courageous enough, you will be ready enough, and you will step into it with confidence, knowing that he who has called you is faithful. 1 Thessalonians 5:24, faithful is he that calleth you, who also will do it. He will do it. Now, let me share one more thought before we go into deep prayer. I want to talk about divine connections as a form of opportunity. [music] In the kingdom of God, the most powerful opportunities often come through people. God's strategy has always been people-centered. He uses people to bless people. He uses connections to open doors. Think about Esther and Mordecai. Think about Paul and Barnabas. Think about Timothy and Paul. Think about Elisha and Elijah. Every major leap in the kingdom has involved a divine connection, a God-ordained relationship that serves as a gateway to destiny. This is why you must pray about your relationships. Not every friend is a divine connection. Not every association is a God-ordained gateway. Some connections will drain you. Some associations will delay you. Some relationships are assignments from the enemy to keep you distracted, to keep you focused on the wrong things, to waste your time, your energy, and your resources. But there are also divine connections. There are people who are called of God to be in your life, people whose gifts will complement yours, people whose access will become your access, people whose word at the right time will shift your entire trajectory. And I am praying for you this morning that God will begin to orchestrate divine connections in your life. That the right people will begin to find their way into your circle. That ungodly, destiny-limiting connections will begin to lose their grip on your life. That you will be divinely repositioned into the company of those who are called to help you fulfill your assignment on this earth. Proverbs 13:20 says, he that walketh with wise men shall be wise, but a companion of fools shall be destroyed. Your association shapes your future. This is not negotiable. The people you walk with will either accelerate your destiny or delay it. So, let us pray. Let us pray with fire. Let us pray with precision. Let us pray with faith. I lift your voice right now. I want you to mean every word. I want you to pray like your life depends on it, because in a real sense, the quality of your morning prayer shapes the quality of your day, and the quality of your days shapes the quality of your life. Let's go into prayer. Father, we come before you this morning with hearts full of gratitude and expectation. We thank you for the blood of Jesus. [music] We thank you that we are not coming before you on the basis of our righteousness, but on the basis of the finished work of Calvary. [music] We are bold to enter into the holiest by the blood of Jesus, by a new and living way. We stand before you, Father, as sons and daughters of the most high God. Not as beggars, not as strangers, but as children coming before a father who loves us and has already gone ahead of us to prepare our way. We receive the spirit of adoption, whereby we cry, Abba Father. We receive access to the throne of grace this morning, [music] and we come boldly. Father, we lift up the prayer that is the title of this morning's encounter. We say with one voice, Father, let opportunities locate us today. Not tomorrow, not next week, not in some distant future. Today. Today, Lord. You are the God who acts with urgency when his children call. You are the God who answered before they call. While they are yet speaking, I will hear. We believe that even before this prayer is finished, you are already moving on our behalf. Even now. Father, even now you are arranging divine appointments. Even now you are softening the hearts of men who hold keys to our next level. Even now you are opening doors that no man can shut. We receive it, Father. We receive it by faith. Now Father, in the name of Jesus, we speak to every spirit of obscurity that has kept us hidden from our opportunities. We rebuke the spirit of hiddenness. We rebuke the spirit of delay. We rebuke every demonic assignment against our visibility, against our momentum, against our progress. Every prince of Persia, every satanic principality that has been standing between us and our breakthroughs, we command you to stand down right now in the name of Jesus. The lion of the tribe of Judah has prevailed. The blood of Jesus speaks against every embargo on our destiny this morning. We plead the blood of Jesus over our careers, over our businesses, over our ministries, over our families, over our health, over every area where the enemy has built a wall of limitation. Let fire fall on that wall right now in the name of Jesus. Let every wall of Jericho fall flat. We march around it not seven times but by faith, we declare in this moment that the walls are coming down. Father, you said in Isaiah 45, >> [music] >> "I will go before thee and make the crooked places straight. I will break in pieces the gates of brass and cut in sunder the bars of iron." This morning we call that promise into manifestation. Break the gates of brass, Father. Cut through the bars of iron. Let every stubborn door that has resisted our destiny be broken open in the name of Jesus. Let every rusted hinge begin to turn. >> [music] >> Let every closed chapter that was closed prematurely be reopened by divine order. Let every opportunity that the enemy stole from us, every door that the thief shut, every moment that was hijacked by the adversary, we call it [music] back. We call it back. We call it back in the name of Jesus. Father, send help from your sanctuary. Psalm 20:2 says, "Send thee help from the sanctuary and strengthen thee out of Zion." We receive help from the sanctuary this morning. We receive supernatural reinforcement. We receive angelic assistance. Let the angels that are ministering spirits go forth on our behalf. Let them clear every path. Let them open every door. Let them announce our arrival in rooms that are connected to our destiny. Send help, Father. Not the kind of help that fails. Not the help of man that is like a broken reed that pierces the hand. Send help that comes from on high. Send the kind of help that Joseph encountered in the prison. Send the kind of help that Ruth encountered in the field. Send the kind of help that suddenly shifts a man from one level to another without warning. Now Father, I pray for divine connections this morning. Lord, you know the name of every person who is supposed to be in my life. You know the name of every man, every woman, every destiny helper, every Boaz, every Barnabas that you have ordained to walk this road with me. Father, I pray that you begin to align those connections. Begin to engineer those divine encounters. Remove from my path every relationship that is an enemy assignment. Every connection that is draining my grace, wasting my time, limiting my vision, let it give way. Not with drama, not with chaos, but let it gracefully dissolve. Let every ungodly soul tie be broken in the name of Jesus. And in the space that is created, Father, fill it with the right people. The covenant people, the people who carry my frequency, the people who speak the same kingdom language, the people who will sharpen me as iron sharpens iron. I speak to my Boaz this morning. I speak to my Barnabas. I speak to my Elijah. Wherever you are, whoever you are, God is speaking to your heart right now. God is arranging a path between us. I will not miss you. You will not miss me. By divine orchestration, we will encounter each other in the fullness of time and the meeting will produce what God [music] has ordained it to produce. I declare this by faith in the name of Jesus. Father, let my gift begin to make [music] room. Proverbs 18:16, let the gift that you have placed in me begin to open doors that I cannot open by myself. Let the anointing that rests upon my life begin to create demand. Let the grace that you have placed on my gifts begin to draw the attention of the right people at the right time. I will not beg for what my gift can attract. I will not manipulate for what your favor can produce. I will not chase what your hand can cause to find me. So Father, anoint my gifts afresh this morning. Let there be a freshness, a new dimension, a new level of excellence, a new depth of grace on everything that I put my hands to. Let there be a fire on my gifts that makes them irresistible to those who need what I carry. Father, I stand on Deuteronomy 28:2, "The blessings of the Lord shall come upon me and overtake me because I hearken to the voice of the Lord my God." Let blessings overtake me today. Let opportunities overtake me today. Let favor overtake me today. Let the right encounters chase me down today. I will not have to chase them. They will chase me. They will find me. They will locate me. Today, Father. Today, I pray now against the spirit of fear. For God has not given me a spirit of fear, but of power and of love and of a sound mind. Every fear that has kept me from stepping into opportunity, I cast it out in the name of Jesus. Fear of failure, go. Fear of rejection, go. Fear of inadequacy, go. The spirit of inferiority that makes me shrink back from greatness, I rebuke it in the name of Jesus. I am the righteousness of God in Christ Jesus. I have not been given a spirit of timidity. I have been called to stand before kings. I have been created for rooms that are greater than the rooms I've been occupying. And today I am stepping into those rooms by faith. I speak to the spirit of timing over my life. Father, let me be at the right place at the right time today. Every divine appointment that has been arranged for me today, let me not miss it. Let me be sensitive to your leading. Let me be obedient to the prompting of your spirit. If you say turn left, let my spirit be sensitive enough to turn left. If you say speak to that person, let me not let shyness or distraction cause me to miss the moment. Let me be fully present, fully alert, fully surrendered to your guidance today. Because sometimes the opportunity comes disguised. Sometimes the door is not marked with a sign. Sometimes the divine appointment looks ordinary on the outside. So Father, give me eyes to see and ears to hear that I may recognize my moments when they come. For everyone listening to this prayer right now, whether you are watching this live or you are watching the replay, the anointing that is present in this moment is not restricted by time. The spirit of God is eternal. The anointing that was released in this prayer is finding you wherever you are. If you are in a different time zone, if you are watching this months from now, the spirit of God is reaching into your moment, into your day, and he is releasing what he has ordained for you in this season. Receive it. Open your hands. Open your heart. Say, "Father, I receive it. Let it locate me. Let it find me. Let it manifest in my life beginning today." Now I am going to pray for specific categories of people because God told [music] me to. If you are a young person just starting out, if you are at the beginning of your journey, I pray that God gives you a head start that makes up for every year the locust has eaten. That you will encounter divine acceleration. That what took others decades, God will compress into seasons for you. That you will stand before great men while you are still young. That your youth will not be a limitation because God does not discriminate by age. He used [music] David while he was a teenager. He used Jeremiah while he was a child. He uses whoever he chooses. And today he is choosing you. If you are in a season of waiting, if you have been in the pit like Joseph, if you have been in the prison, if it feels like every door has been shut and every pathway blocked, I [music] want to speak to you directly. Your waiting season is not wasted. God is not sleeping. God is not slow. 2 Peter 3:9 says, "The Lord is not slack concerning his promise." He is not late. He is not early. He is always exactly on time. And the fact that you are still standing, the fact that you woke up this morning, the fact that you are in this place of prayer rather than giving up is evidence that God has not finished with your story. The butler forgot Joseph but God did not forget Joseph. And God has not forgotten you. If you are a business person, an entrepreneur, someone who has been laboring without breakthrough, I speak to the spirit of multiplication over your business right now. I speak to the anointing of open doors over your enterprise. The right clients are coming. The right contracts are coming. The right investors, the right partnerships, the right platforms are coming. What you have built in the season of obscurity is about to be seen. What you have labored for in the hidden place [music] is about to be rewarded openly. Matthew 6:4, "Your Father which seeth in secret shall reward thee openly." Openly. Not in a corner. Not quietly. Openly, publicly, visibly, undeniably. Let it happen, Father. Let it happen in this season. If you are believing God for ministry doors, if you carry a message, if you have a word burning in your bones like fire shut up in your bones, if God has given you something to say and the platform has not yet arrived. I declare to you this morning that the word of the Lord will find its audience. The message that God has put in you will create the platform that it needs. You will not die with the message inside you. You will not go to the grave with the word undelivered. God will open the doors. God will create the stages. God will cause the microphone to find your voice. Speak in the name of Jesus. Father, now I come before you in a posture of deep gratitude and confident faith. I have prayed. I have declared. I have decreed. And now I stand in faith knowing that the word of God does not return void. Isaiah 55:11. My word shall not return unto me void, but it shall accomplish that which I please and it shall [music] prosper in the thing where to I sent it. The word that has been released this morning is alive with power. The declarations that have been made are seeds sown into the soil of this season. They will produce a harvest. They will come back to us in the form of open doors, divine appointments, supernatural breakthroughs, and overflowing opportunities. Father, seal everything that has been prayed this morning with the blood of Jesus. Let every word be underwritten by the power of your spirit. Let no backlash come from the enemy. Let no retaliation follow these prayers. We are covered by the blood. We are hidden in Christ. Colossians 3:3. Our life is hid with Christ in God. You cannot touch what is hidden in God. We are untouchable to the enemy. We are covered. We are sealed. We are protected by the blood of the lamb and the word of our testimony. Now, I want you to share this prayer. If this has blessed you, if something shifted in your spirit as you prayed, don't keep it to yourself. Share it with a friend. Share it with your family. Share it with someone who needs a breakthrough today. Someone who is in a season of waiting. Someone who has been knocking on closed doors. Someone who needs to know that God has not forgotten them. Let this prayer find them. Let this word reach them. Because sometimes the most powerful thing you can do for someone is not give them money or advice, but connect them to a moment of genuine encounter with the living God. Share this message. And for you, whoever you are, wherever you're watching from, I want to close with this. You are not an accident. Your life is not a mistake. The fact that you found this prayer this morning is itself a divine appointment. God led you here because he has something he's releasing into your life in this season. The doors that have been closed are about to open. The opportunities that have been hidden are about to locate you. The connections that have been delayed are about to arrive. The gifts that have been dormant are about to be activated. The season of obscurity is ending. The season of visibility is beginning. I declare it over your life in the name of Jesus and heaven is the witness of this declaration. Rise up in faith. Go into your day knowing that you are sent. You are anointed. You are favored. You are equipped. And the God who began a good work in you is faithful to [music] complete it until the day of Jesus Christ. Let every opportunity that is ordained for you today find you in the name of Jesus. Amen and amen. God bless you. Go and conquer this day. >> [music]
